lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity blobs are positioned at the intersections of faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal rows, creating a defined grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical intensity gradients with lighter pixels on the dorsal side of the ridge and darker pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant reduction in spot diameter and increase in spatial density moving anteriorly from the gills towards the cephalic region.
